title: Desk Note: A Returned-Remittance Delinquency Open Alongside an Employer-Liable Shortfall
content:
Another delinquency open at the same time adds to the late charge rate on a shortfall notice the employer is liable for under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement. The other item is the deduction schedule named by the remittance return booked most recently on the agreement, where that return is the only one booked that day:

| Open amount of that deduction schedule | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| at least 40000 US dollars | 0.2 |
| above zero but below 40000 US dollars | 0.1 |
| zero | none |
| no such item: no remittance return, or more than one return booked on the latest return day | none |

The open amount of that schedule is its schedule amount less the remittances and write-offs pointing to it, plus the remittance returns pointing to it.

Cases (hypothetical): a schedule reinstated by the latest return and still open by 41200.00 adds 0.2 points; one open by 6300.00 adds 0.1; one since remitted in full adds none.
